scenario: Grouping does not merge distinct commercial products
actual: FAIL: merged into ONE product external_ref=AUD-IMP named "ورق اختبار ٦" with variants AUD-IMP-6 (500) and AUD-IMP-7 (800). Rule: any code ending in -N is grouped under its base when ≥2 codes share the base (AUD-IMP-3..7 → base AUD-IMP), regardless of differing names/prices; the server only warns product_field_conflict (first row wins).

scenario: Import with images supplied as a ZIP (browser)
expected: images uploaded to the job prefix, rows staged, drafts created
actual: FAIL: every image upload returns HTTP 400 {statusCode:415, error:invalid_mime_type, message:"mime type application/octet-stream is not supported"}. ZIP entries are wrapped in a Blob without a type (import-wizard.tsx onImages → new Blob([bytes])), so supabase-js sends the multipart part as application/octet-stream and the contentType option is ignored. Job stays status=created with 0 rows; UI shows only the generic "حدث خطأ. حاول مرة أخرى.". The earlier 1,200-row acceptance did not catch it because it uploaded Node Buffers, not browser Blobs. Follow-up (cleanup inventory): the same job (1f866ffa) stayed in created for ~4 min and only progressed when the seller retried with individual image files (same idempotency key), so the job is not permanently stuck — but a seller who does not retry is left with an orphan created job and no actionable error.
